metadata.title: Source code and data for "trRosettaRNA: automated prediction of RNA 3D structure with transformer network"
metadata.description:
Source code for trRosettaRNA (published in https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-42528-4).

The corresponding web server is available at https://yanglab.qd.sdu.edu.cn/trRosettaRNA/.

The NC paper version: v1.0

The standalone packages have been enhanced to support custom secondary structure files as input.
